'''Ashraf Iskandar oglu Huseynov''' ({{langx|az|Əşrəf İskəndər oğlu Hüseynov}}, September 20, 1907, Amirvarli, [[Jabrayil District]] — August 26, 1981, [[Baku]]) was an [[Azerbaijani people|Azerbaijani]] [[mathematician]] (professor from 1948, member of [[Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences]] from 1962). His area of contributions embraced nonlinear [[singular integral equations]], [[differential equations]], [[potential theory]] and [[functional analysis]]. 

Huseynov was the first to study the nonlinear [[Hilbert problem]] as applied to [[analytic functions]].<ref name="ASE">''Azerbaijan Soviet Encyclopedia'' (1987), vol. 10, p. 285</ref> He also created the ''H<sub>α, β, γ</sub>'' [[function space]] and proved some [[theorem]]s for nonlinear singular integral equations with [[Cauchy kernel]] within that space.<ref name="ASE" /> Huseynov held positions in some Azerbaijani scientific institutions.
